text: Environmental Engineering is an interdisciplinary subject that studies and solves problems related to environmental pollution prevention and control, ecological protection and resource recycling, integrating knowledge from multiple fields such as engineering, chemistry, biology, ecology and management. Its core objective is to achieve pollutant control (such as water/air/solid waste treatment), environmental quality improvement and sustainable development through technological research and development, engineering design and management measures. It is an important supporting discipline for ecological civilization construction.
